source_policy: The four supplied all-tier male workbooks are authoritative for new male labeling projects. Identical Foundation and Development bowling copies are represented once from the pace workbook. Existing projects remain version-locked to their original rubric.

routing.tier_selection_rule: Treat age bands as hints only. The source ranges overlap around age 9 and leave an approximate 13-15 gap, so the annotator must explicitly select the workbook tier.

score_policy.null_policy: Blank/null means not observed or not applicable; zero means observed and clearly at the lowest anchor.
score_policy.aggregation: Mean non-null delivery scores per KPI, then calculate the weight-adjusted mean across scored KPIs only.
score_policy.categorical_note: Foundation sheets define explicit 0/5/10 anchors. Development and advanced sheets define GREEN/AMBER/RED anchors while retaining an expert 0-10 field; intermediate scores require human judgement and evidence.

kpis.name: Basic Stance & Grip

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player has a stable base and holds the bat with two hands, facing the bowler. Side/front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player has a stable base and holds the bat with two hands, facing the bowler. Side/front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = no stable stance or grip, bat held incorrectly or one-handed. 5 = holding the bat reasonably but stance unstable. 10 = stable stance, two hands on the bat, facing the bowler.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: no stable stance or grip, bat held incorrectly or one-handed.
kpis.notes: Kept to 3 anchor points (0/5/10) rather than fine gradations — simpler for both the model to judge consistently and for a coach to explain to a young player.

kpis.name: Watching the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the head and eyes track the ball from the bowler's hand. Front-on and side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the head and eyes track the ball from the bowler's hand. Front-on and side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = not watching, looking away or distracted. 5 = watching inconsistently. 10 = eyes clearly on the ball from the bowler's hand through delivery.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: not watching, looking away or distracted.
kpis.notes: Head/eye tracking remains one of the more reliable visual reads at any age.

kpis.name: Positive Attempt

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player commits to playing the ball rather than flinching away. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player commits to playing the ball rather than flinching away. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = flinches away, no attempt to play the ball. 5 = hesitant, half-attempt. 10 = confidently commits to playing the ball.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: flinches away, no attempt to play the ball.
kpis.notes: Effort-based, not outcome-based — deliberately rewards trying, which matches how youth coaching frameworks treat this age group (all forms of effort praised, not just clean technique).

kpis.name: Moving Feet Toward the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Any attempt to move the feet toward the ball, in either direction. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Any attempt to move the feet toward the ball, in either direction. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = flat-footed, no foot movement at all. 5 = some movement but late or uncertain. 10 = a clear attempt to move the feet toward the ball, forward or back — direction doesn't matter yet at this stage.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: flat-footed, no foot movement at all.
kpis.notes: Deliberately does NOT distinguish front-foot vs back-foot at this age — that distinction is a Development-tier skill, not a Foundation one. Just checking feet move at all.

kpis.name: Bat Swing Through the Line

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the bat swings through toward the ball on a reasonably straight path. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the bat swings through toward the ball on a reasonably straight path. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = wild swing, bat nowhere near the ball's line. 5 = swings but mistimed or off-line. 10 = swings through on a reasonably straight path toward the ball.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: wild swing, bat nowhere near the ball's line.
kpis.notes: Categorical only — no degree measurement, just does the swing path look roughly right.

kpis.name: Contact Attempt Quality

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the bat makes solid contact with the ball. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the bat makes solid contact with the ball. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = no contact, clean miss. 5 = partial or edge contact. 10 = clean-ish contact with the bat.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: no contact, clean miss.
kpis.notes: Simple hit/partial/miss read — reliable and age-appropriate.

kpis.name: Balance at Finish

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player stays on their feet and roughly balanced after the shot. Side and front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player stays on their feet and roughly balanced after the shot. Side and front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: 0 = falls over or completely loses balance. 5 = some wobble. 10 = stays on feet, roughly balanced.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: falls over or completely loses balance.
kpis.notes: Coarse body-shape read, one of the most reliable categories for a vision model regardless of age group.

kpis.name: Balanced Stance & Grip

view_requirement.source_text: Stance stability and correct two-handed grip at guard. Side/front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Stance stability and correct two-handed grip at guard. Side/front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = stable, balanced stance, correct grip. AMBER = mostly right, slightly unstable or grip a little off. RED = unstable stance or incorrect grip.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: unstable stance or incorrect grip.
kpis.notes: Introduces the G/A/R language used from here through the adult sheets, but with generous, simple thresholds.

kpis.name: Head Position & Watching the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Head stillness and eyes tracking the ball. Front-on and side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Head stillness and eyes tracking the ball. Front-on and side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = still, clearly watching from the bowler's hand. AMBER = some movement or slightly late picking up the ball. RED = head moving a lot, or clearly not watching.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: head moving a lot, or clearly not watching.
kpis.notes: Same reliable read carried up from Foundation tier, now in G/A/R form.

kpis.name: Backlift Height & Timing

view_requirement.source_text: Whether a backlift happens and is roughly timed to the bowler. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether a backlift happens and is roughly timed to the bowler. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear backlift, roughly timed to the bowler's approach. AMBER = backlift present but low or a bit early/late. RED = no real backlift, or badly mistimed.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: no real backlift, or badly mistimed.
kpis.notes: Generous tolerance band — timing precision expected of an adult isn't expected here.

kpis.name: Decisive Forward Movement

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player moves forward with reasonable commitment when the ball is full. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player moves forward with reasonable commitment when the ball is full. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear, committed forward movement. AMBER = some forward movement but hesitant. RED = little to no forward movement on a ball that needed it.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: little to no forward movement on a ball that needed it.
kpis.notes: Only score if this session had deliveries the player moved forward for — leave blank otherwise. Coarse forward/back distinction only, not depth or fine timing.

kpis.name: Decisive Backward Movement

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player moves back with reasonable commitment when the ball is shorter. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player moves back with reasonable commitment when the ball is shorter. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear, committed backward movement. AMBER = some backward movement but hesitant. RED = little to no backward movement on a ball that needed it.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: little to no backward movement on a ball that needed it.
kpis.notes: Only score if this session had deliveries the player moved back for — leave blank otherwise.

kpis.name: Bat Face Control at Contact

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the bat face looks reasonably controlled at contact. Behind-wicket view.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the bat face looks reasonably controlled at contact. Behind-wicket view.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = controlled, roughly straight face. AMBER = slightly open or closed. RED = clearly open or closed face at contact.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly open or closed face at contact.
kpis.notes: Same categorical read used across the adult sheets, generous thresholds.

kpis.name: Contact Point Near the Body

view_requirement.source_text: Whether contact happens reasonably close to the body rather than at arm's length. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether contact happens reasonably close to the body rather than at arm's length. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = contact close to the body. AMBER = a little away from the body. RED = reaching, playing well away from the body.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: reaching, playing well away from the body.
kpis.notes: Simplified version of the adult 'under the eyes' KPI — coarser tolerance.

kpis.name: Top-Hand Control

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the top hand appears to lead the shot rather than the bottom hand rolling early.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the top hand appears to lead the shot rather than the bottom hand rolling early.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = top-hand led. AMBER = some bottom-hand involvement. RED = clearly bottom-hand dominated, wrists rolling early.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly bottom-hand dominated, wrists rolling early.
kpis.notes: Same reliable read as the adult sheets.

kpis.name: Follow Through Extension

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the shot completes with reasonable extension rather than being checked. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the shot completes with reasonable extension rather than being checked. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = good extension through the shot. AMBER = partial follow-through. RED = shot completely checked.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: shot completely checked.
kpis.notes: Coarse body-shape read.

kpis.name: Balance at Completion

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the player finishes roughly balanced. Side and front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the player finishes roughly balanced. Side and front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = balanced finish. AMBER = some wobble. RED = falls over or clearly off-balance.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: falls over or clearly off-balance.
kpis.notes: Same reliable read as Foundation tier, now in G/A/R form.

kpis.name: Reasonable Shot Choice for the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the general idea of the shot suits the delivery — not fine length/line precision, just the basic idea.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the general idea of the shot suits the delivery — not fine length/line precision, just the basic idea.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = shot choice makes sense for the ball. AMBER = a debatable or slightly early/late decision. RED = clearly the wrong idea for the delivery (e.g. trying to smash a very full ball high in the air with no control).
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly the wrong idea for the delivery (e.g.
kpis.notes: Deliberately coarser than the adult Shot Intelligence KPI — judging the basic idea, not precise length/line reading.

kpis.name: Consistency / Repeatable Technique

view_requirement.source_text: Whether technique holds up reasonably across the session rather than falling apart.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether technique holds up reasonably across the session rather than falling apart.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = fairly consistent across deliveries. AMBER = some noticeable variation. RED = technique breaks down significantly across the session.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: technique breaks down significantly across the session.
kpis.notes: Same principle as the adult sheets, generous tolerance for natural variability at this age.

kpis.name: Balanced Stance & Weight Distribution

view_requirement.source_text: Weight distribution and readiness at guard, side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Weight distribution and readiness at guard, side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = balanced or slight forward lean, weight on balls of feet, ready to move either way fast. AMBER = slightly back-footed or narrow base. RED = clearly weight-back or over-wide, will struggle to react to pace.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly weight-back or over-wide, will struggle to react to pace.
kpis.notes: Against genuine pace the stance must allow an equally fast front OR back decision — this is what's actually being judged, not stance style in isolation.

kpis.name: Head Position & Stillness at Guard

view_requirement.source_text: Head stillness and level eyes before delivery. Front-on and side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Head stillness and level eyes before delivery. Front-on and side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = still, eyes level, no pre-delivery movement. AMBER = slight movement/trigger. RED = head tilting or drifting before the ball is released.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: head tilting or drifting before the ball is released.
kpis.notes: Head stillness is one of the more reliably trackable cues for a vision model — the head is a large, legible feature across frames.

kpis.name: Bat Position at Guard

view_requirement.source_text: Bat resting position and readiness at guard. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Bat resting position and readiness at guard. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = controlled, comfortable resting position, straight or near-straight face. AMBER = slightly open/closed. RED = clearly open or closed face at rest.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly open or closed face at rest.
kpis.notes: Categorical read — exact degree of bat face at rest isn't reliably estimable from phone video, the open/controlled/closed pattern is.

kpis.name: Backlift Height & Timing vs Pace

view_requirement.source_text: Height and timing of backlift relative to the bowler's approach. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Height and timing of backlift relative to the bowler's approach. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = full backlift, triggered in sync with the bowler entering the delivery stride. AMBER = slightly early/late or a touch low. RED = no real backlift, or badly mistimed relative to release.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: no real backlift, or badly mistimed relative to release.
kpis.notes: Against pace, mistimed backlift is far more costly than against spin — there's no time to recover. Categorical read of sync + height together, not an isolated degree measurement.

kpis.name: Backlift Direction

view_requirement.source_text: Whether backlift goes toward gully/point (lateral) or stays straight. Front-on view.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether backlift goes toward gully/point (lateral) or stays straight. Front-on view.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = toward gully/point (lateral backlift) or controlled straight-back, both are valid. AMBER = slightly toward fine leg. RED = extreme fine-leg-only direction.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: extreme fine-leg-only direction.
kpis.notes: Research shows lateral backlift toward gully correlates with elite performance — do not penalise it as a fault.

kpis.name: Front Foot Initiation & Decisiveness vs Pace

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the front foot moves early and decisively toward the pitch of the ball once length is picked. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the front foot moves early and decisively toward the pitch of the ball once length is picked. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = moves early and commits fully, no hesitation. AMBER = slightly late or a half-committed movement. RED = very late, or foot barely moves at all — reacting to pace, not reading it.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: very late, or foot barely moves at all — reacting to pace, not reading it.
kpis.notes: Only score on deliveries classified as front-foot. Leave blank if this session had no front-foot deliveries.

kpis.name: Front Foot Landing Direction

view_requirement.source_text: Where the front foot lands relative to the line of the ball. Front-on.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Where the front foot lands relative to the line of the ball. Front-on.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = landing in line with or toward the ball. AMBER = slightly across or reaching. RED = foot crossing well past the ball's line, or badly across the body.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: foot crossing well past the ball's line, or badly across the body.
kpis.notes: Categorical direction read — reliable. Exact cm-from-crease figures are not.

kpis.name: Head & Weight Over the Front Knee at Contact

view_requirement.source_text: Whether head and weight stay forward and over the front knee through contact. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether head and weight stay forward and over the front knee through contact. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = head and weight clearly forward over the knee at contact. AMBER = slightly upright or weight neutral. RED = falling away, weight staying back, head pulling away from the ball.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: falling away, weight staying back, head pulling away from the ball.
kpis.notes: Classic pace-specific fault — playing away from the body under time pressure.

kpis.name: Back Foot Initiation & Decisiveness vs Pace

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the back foot moves back and across early and decisively for the short ball. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the back foot moves back and across early and decisively for the short ball. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear, early, committed back-and-across movement. AMBER = a late or partial movement. RED = caught flat-footed, no real back-foot movement against a shorter length.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: caught flat-footed, no real back-foot movement against a shorter length.
kpis.notes: Only score on deliveries classified as back-foot. Leave blank if this session had no back-foot deliveries.

kpis.name: Depth & Balance of Back Foot Movement

view_requirement.source_text: How far back and across the batter moves, and balance through the movement. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: How far back and across the batter moves, and balance through the movement. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = good depth, balanced throughout. AMBER = shallow movement or slight balance loss. RED = minimal depth, clearly off-balance or falling over.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: minimal depth, clearly off-balance or falling over.
kpis.notes: Depth against genuine pace creates the time to play the short ball safely — this is what's being judged.

kpis.name: Weight Transfer Into the Shot vs Pace

view_requirement.source_text: Whether weight moves controllably into the shot at contact rather than falling away from the stumps. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether weight moves controllably into the shot at contact rather than falling away from the stumps. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = controlled weight into the shot. AMBER = weight staying fairly neutral. RED = weight falling backward/away, defensive and unbalanced.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: weight falling backward/away, defensive and unbalanced.
kpis.notes: Distinct from the spin version of this KPI — against pace this is about controlling a fast, heavy ball, not generating power off a slow one.

kpis.name: Bat Face Control at Contact

view_requirement.source_text: Bat face angle at the moment of contact. Behind-wicket view.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Bat face angle at the moment of contact. Behind-wicket view.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = straight/controlled face. AMBER = slightly open or closed. RED = clearly open or closed face at contact, likely to mis-hit or edge.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly open or closed face at contact, likely to mis-hit or edge.
kpis.notes: Categorical read, not an exact degree — single-camera degree estimation at a fast-moving contact instant is not reliable.

kpis.name: Contact Point — Under the Eyes

view_requirement.source_text: Where contact happens relative to the body. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Where contact happens relative to the body. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = ball met close to the body, under or near the eyes. AMBER = slightly away from the body. RED = reaching, playing at arm's length away from the body.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: reaching, playing at arm's length away from the body.
kpis.notes: Classic pace-specific cue — against genuine pace, playing away from the body sharply raises edge/dismissal risk.

kpis.name: Top-Hand Control vs Bottom-Hand Dominance

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the top hand leads the shot or the bottom hand rolls early. Side view.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the top hand leads the shot or the bottom hand rolls early. Side view.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = top-hand led, controlled. AMBER = some bottom-hand dominance. RED = extreme bottom-hand dominance, wrists rolling before contact.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: extreme bottom-hand dominance, wrists rolling before contact.
kpis.notes: Reliable categorical read — timing of wrist roll relative to contact is visually clear even without precise frame counting.

kpis.name: Response to Short-Pitched Bowling
kpis.applies_to: Conditional — only if a short/bouncer-length ball appears in the clip

view_requirement.source_text: Reaction to a short ball specifically — duck, sway, pull, or defend. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Reaction to a short ball specifically — duck, sway, pull, or defend. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = controlled, deliberate response (ducks/sways under control, or pulls/cuts with control). AMBER = rushed but safe. RED = flustered, mistimed, or hit while attempting a shot with no control.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: flustered, mistimed, or hit while attempting a shot with no control.
kpis.notes: Leave blank entirely if no short ball appears in the session's clips — do not force a score.

kpis.name: Follow Through Extension & Balance

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the shot is completed with full extension and a balanced finish, or checked/off-balance. Side and front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the shot is completed with full extension and a balanced finish, or checked/off-balance. Side and front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = full extension, balanced finish. AMBER = partial follow-through or slight imbalance. RED = shot completely checked, or clearly falling over at completion.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: shot completely checked, or clearly falling over at completion.
kpis.notes: Merged extension and balance into one categorical read — both are coarse body-shape judgements a vision model handles reliably together.

kpis.name: Head Stability Through Shot

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the head stays down and still through contact and follow-through. Side and front angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the head stays down and still through contact and follow-through. Side and front angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = head stays down through contact and follow-through. AMBER = slight early movement. RED = head lifts clearly before or at contact.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: head lifts clearly before or at contact.
kpis.notes: Reliable — head tracking across frames is one of the more trustworthy visual reads available.

kpis.name: Length & Line Judgement Under Pace

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the shot selected matches the length and line bowled, under time pressure.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the shot selected matches the length and line bowled, under time pressure.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clearly appropriate shot for the delivery. AMBER = debatable/borderline call. RED = clearly wrong shot for the length (e.g. driving a short ball, hanging back on a full one).
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly wrong shot for the length (e.g.
kpis.notes: Coarse read is reliable — a clearly wrong shot for the delivery is visually obvious even without frame-perfect length classification.

kpis.name: Consistency Across Session

view_requirement.source_text: Whether technique holds up across multiple deliveries faced at pace.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether technique holds up across multiple deliveries faced at pace.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = consistent technique across deliveries. AMBER = some variation. RED = technique breaks down noticeably as the session goes on.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: technique breaks down noticeably as the session goes on.
kpis.notes: Compare patterns across clips directly rather than a single-clip snapshot — same principle as the injury model's fatigue/consistency markers.

kpis.name: Balanced Stance & Readiness

view_requirement.source_text: Stance and readiness at guard, side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Stance and readiness at guard, side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = balanced, relaxed, ready to move decisively either direction. AMBER = slightly rigid or narrow. RED = clearly anchored/flat-footed, unlikely to move freely.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly anchored/flat-footed, unlikely to move freely.
kpis.notes: Against spin there's more time, so a slightly more open/relaxed stance than the pace-mode ideal is normal and should not be penalised on its own.

kpis.name: Head Position & Watching the Hand

view_requirement.source_text: Head stillness and whether the player appears to track the bowler's hand/release, not just the point of release. Front-on and side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Head stillness and whether the player appears to track the bowler's hand/release, not just the point of release. Front-on and side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = still head, clearly tracking from the hand. AMBER = slight late pickup. RED = head moving early, or clearly picking the ball up late off the pitch instead of the hand.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: head moving early, or clearly picking the ball up late off the pitch instead of the hand.
kpis.notes: Coaching literature is explicit that watching from the hand, not just release, is a core spin-reading skill — distinct emphasis from the pace-mode version of this KPI.

kpis.name: Bat Position at Guard

view_requirement.source_text: Bat resting position at guard. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Bat resting position at guard. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = controlled, comfortable, straight or near-straight. AMBER = slightly open/closed. RED = clearly open or closed face at rest.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: clearly open or closed face at rest.
kpis.notes: Same categorical read as pace mode — this doesn't change with bowling type.

kpis.name: Backlift Height & Timing vs Spin

view_requirement.source_text: Height and timing of backlift relative to the spinner's release. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Height and timing of backlift relative to the spinner's release. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = full backlift, timed comfortably, not rushed. AMBER = slightly early/late. RED = no real backlift or badly mistimed.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: no real backlift or badly mistimed.
kpis.notes: More time is available against spin than pace, so timing tolerance here is naturally wider — judge against what's comfortable for a slower delivery, not the pace-mode window.

kpis.name: Backlift Direction

view_requirement.source_text: Backlift direction — lateral toward gully/point vs straight. Front-on.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Backlift direction — lateral toward gully/point vs straight. Front-on.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = lateral toward gully/point or controlled straight-back. AMBER = slightly toward fine leg. RED = extreme fine-leg-only direction.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: extreme fine-leg-only direction.
kpis.notes: Same research-backed read as pace mode — lateral backlift is not a fault.

kpis.name: Decisive Advance to the Pitch of the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Whether the batter commits fully and early to advancing down the pitch, or gets stuck between advancing and staying back. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether the batter commits fully and early to advancing down the pitch, or gets stuck between advancing and staying back. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear, early, fully-committed advance, reaching or getting close to the pitch of the ball. AMBER = a partial or slightly late advance. RED = caught halfway — neither committed forward nor back, off-balance as a result.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: caught halfway — neither committed forward nor back, off-balance as a result.
kpis.notes: This is the single most commonly cited technical fault against spin in coaching literature — getting stuck between front and back foot. Given its own dedicated, highly-weighted KPI rather than folding it into a generic footwork score.

kpis.name: Front Foot Landing at or Beyond the Pitch of the Ball

view_requirement.source_text: Where the front foot actually lands relative to where the ball pitches. Front-on and side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Where the front foot actually lands relative to where the ball pitches. Front-on and side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = landing at or just past the pitch of the ball, smothering potential turn. AMBER = landing short of the pitch but still committed forward. RED = landing well short, ball turns past the bat before contact.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: landing well short, ball turns past the bat before contact.
kpis.notes: Distinct from the pace-mode landing KPI — against spin the target is proximity to the pitch of the ball, not line.

kpis.name: Weight Transfer Forward Through the Shot

view_requirement.source_text: Whether weight continues moving forward into the shot through contact. Side angle.

kpis.analysis_instruction: Whether weight continues moving forward into the shot through contact. Side angle.
kpis.scoring_guide: GREEN = clear continued forward weight transfer through contact. AMBER = weight transfer stalls partway. RED = weight stops or falls back before contact, undermining the advance.
kpis.red_or_zero_anchor: weight stops or falls back before contact, undermining the advance.
kpis.notes: An advance that stalls its weight transfer partway is nearly as bad as not advancing — this checks the advance is actually completed, not just initiated.

kpis.name: Decisive Back & Across / Depth of Movement
kpis.group: SECTION 3B — FOOTWORK: BACK-FOOT / DEEP DELIVERIES ONLY
